planning_notes: No explicit serial protocol/reporting requirements were provided; no serial interfaces are requested.
Button polarity (active-high vs active-low) and any pullup usage were not specified; default catalog behavior is assumed for digital_input (no pullup override provided).
The potentiometer-to-blink-period mapping (min/max period, scaling, debounce, units) is unspecified; it must be defined in the SysML model (not in port configuration).

TM1637 display range, numeric formatting (units), and whether displayed value represents milliseconds or another unit are not specified; the model must choose the conversion from potentiometer input to an integer displayed by tm1637_number.

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Start/stop button (press to start, press again to stop)

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: Blink LED output; when stopped, LED must be off

configuration_resolution.original_requirement: 实现一个可配置闪烁系统，使用 LED D13、电位器 A0、按钮 D2 和 TM1637（CLK=D4，DIO=D5）。电位器控制闪烁周期，数码管显示周期值；按钮用于启动和停止闪烁，停止时 LED 熄灭但保留当前周期设置。
